articles.summary: LONGVIEW, Texas, Aug. 07, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Friedman Industries, Incorporated (NASDAQ/GS: FRD) announced today its results of operations for the quarter ended June 30, 2025. June 30, 2025 Quarter Highlights: Sales of $134.8 million with a 12% increase in tons sold year-over-year Net earnings
articles.title: Friedman Industries, Incorporated Announces First Quarter Results
